errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.AUTH_INACTIVE: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.

errors.IMPORT_HEADERS_INVALID: The column headings do not match the template.
errors.IMPORT_NOT_FOUND: This check has expired. Check the file again.

errors.RECEIVED_EXCEEDS_SENT: More arrived than was sent ({{sent}} sent).

errors.COMPANY_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Fill in the company name, address and phone in Settings first.
errors.HAS_STOCK: This product still has {{units}} in stock.
errors.DAMAGED_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED: Damaged cannot be more than received.
errors.PO_ITEM_MISMATCH: That line does not belong to this order.
errors.PO_SUPPLIER_MISMATCH: The order belongs to a different supplier.
errors.GRN_MISMATCH: That receipt is not a posted receipt from this supplier.

errors.NOT_ON_COUNT_LIST: That item is not on this count.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Sales, stock and finance widgets arrive in later phases. Pick up where you left off below.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: These details print on every invoice. Required: legal name, address line 1 and at least one phone.
company.logoHelp: Original file only. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Never recolored or cropped.
company.previewHelp: Live preview of the invoice header and footer built from this form. The full PDF arrives in Phase 3.
company.previewBlocked: Invoice generation is blocked until legal name, address line 1 and a phone number are filled in.

branches.title: Branches & warehouses
branches.subtitle: One branch at launch; the schema is multi-branch ready.
branches.emptyLocations: No storage locations yet. Add racks, shelves and bins so stock can be placed precisely.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Each staff member has their own login and role.

users.mustChangePassword: Require password change at next login
users.pinHelp: Used to approve discounts and price overrides at the POS.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be signed out and cannot log in.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Tick what each role may do. Super admin always has every permission.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.subtitle: Document number formats. Numbers are gap-free and generated inside the document's transaction.

masterData.subtitle: Lists the product catalogue is built from. Inactive rows stay on old records but cannot be picked again.
masterData.lookupsSubtitle: Short pick-lists such as quality grade, glass type and colour finish. System lists cannot be deleted.
masterData.customFieldsSubtitle: Extra fields on products, variants, customers and suppliers. They appear in the editor and can show on the POS card.

masterData.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.
masterData.requiredHint: A draft can be saved without it; publishing is blocked until it is filled.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Mirrors, glass and parts, with every size, side and feature as a variant.
products.newSubtitle: Start with the basics. The product is saved as a draft and goes live when you publish it.
products.searchPlaceholder: Name, code, SKU, barcode, OEM no. or vehicle

products.aliasesHint: Other barcodes that scan to this variant, separated by commas.
products.sizeLabelHint: Leave empty to build it from width and height.
products.lastCostHint: Set by purchases in a later phase.
products.pricingHint: Edit a price and save. Rows with unsaved changes are sent together.
products.pricingLocked: You can see prices but not change them. Ask an owner or manager.
products.stockHint: When stock falls to the reorder level the item is flagged for purchasing.

hints.fitments: Link variants (by SKU) to vehicle models and years.

stock.deleteBody: The draft and its lines are removed. Nothing else changes.

inventory.subtitle: What is on the shelf, what is running low, and every movement behind it.
inventory.empty: No stock records yet. Receive goods or load opening stock to begin.
inventory.movementsSubtitle: Every stock posting in one list, newest first. Nothing here can be edited.
inventory.adjustmentsSubtitle: Corrections to stock, each with a reason. Big ones wait for a second person.
inventory.breakageSubtitle: Every breakage and damage, with who, which supplier and what it cost.
inventory.transfersSubtitle: Move stock between warehouses. It leaves the source when sent and arrives when received.
inventory.shortDelivery: Some units did not arrive. A draft adjustment was created at the source so you can put them back or write them off.
inventory.countsSubtitle: Count the shelves and correct the system to what is really there.

inventory.startHint: Start the count to freeze the list and the quantities on file.

inventory.reorderSubtitle: Items at or below their reorder level. Choose a supplier and create purchase order drafts in one click.
inventory.agingSubtitle: How long the stock on the shelf has been there, counted from the newest receipts back.
inventory.valuationSubtitle: What the stock was worth at the end of a day, rebuilt from the movements.

purchasing.openingHint: What you owe them today. Cannot be changed later.
purchasing.balanceHint: From the ledger: receipts less returns.

purchasing.serverTotals: Totals are confirmed by the server when you save.
purchasing.linkCopied: Link copied. It works for 7 days.
purchasing.receiptsSubtitle: Goods that arrived, with freight, duty and other costs spread over the lines.
purchasing.paidToHint: Paid to (empty if the supplier billed it)
purchasing.landedEmpty: Add lines with a quantity and a cost to see the landed cost per unit.
purchasing.supplierOwed: Added to what we owe the supplier
purchasing.receiptPosted: Receipt posted. Stock, cost and the supplier balance are updated.
purchasing.returnsSubtitle: Goods sent back to a supplier.

checks.average_cost_matches_replay: Average costs match a replay of the history
